Same asset linked twice results in one download with one unique hash

```elixir title="Elixir"
engine_config = "{\"download_assets\":true}"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config)
url = "https://example.com"
result = Crawlberg.scrape_async(engine, url)
IO.inspect(result.status_code)
IO.inspect(length(result.assets))
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.assets, 0).content_hash)
```
